fix_attempts.issue: glGetUniformLocation() was called with a raw string every draw call, every frame, from Mesh::Draw, Camera::Matrix, Player::Matrix, and Texture::texUnit - a driver round-trip + string hash on every call.
fix_attempts.fix: Added Shader::GetUniformLocation(name) which caches results in an unordered_map<string, GLint>; updated all 4 call sites to use it. Also removed a redundant shader.Activate() call inside Texture::texUnit.

fix_attempts.issue: Three bugs: (1) `type != "PROGRAM"` compared const char* by pointer, not content; (2) the PROGRAM branch queried glGetShaderiv/GL_COMPILE_STATUS instead of glGetProgramiv/GL_LINK_STATUS, so a failed link was never detected; (3) infoLog was fetched but never printed. Also the vertex shader's compile status was never checked at all.
fix_attempts.fix: Used std::strcmp for the type comparison, switched the PROGRAM branch to glGetProgramiv/GL_LINK_STATUS, printed infoLog in both branches, and added a compileErrors(vertexShader, "VERTEX") call.

known_repo_facts.build_system: No CMake/Makefile. Windows-only build via .vscode/tasks.json invoking g++.exe (MinGW) or MSVC cl.exe. No CI workflow exists besides repo-assist itself.
known_repo_facts.sandbox_build_limitation: This Linux sandbox has no GLFW library, GPU, or X11 - only `g++ -fsyntax-only` / `g++ -c` (compile-to-object, no link) verification is possible here. Full link/run must be verified by a maintainer on Windows.
known_repo_facts.vendored_deps: glad, GLFW (prebuilt .dll/.a), GLM, stb_image, nlohmann json, KHR headers - all vendored under include/ and lib/, not managed by a package manager. Treat any 'dependency update' task with caution since there's no version pinning to check against and updating vendored sources is high-risk without a working build to verify.
known_repo_facts.corridor_component_wip: CorridorComponent (headers/CorridorComponent.h, src/CorridorComponent.cpp) is unfinished WIP from a single early commit ('starting to work on components'). It's not wired into the build (tasks.json build task doesn't compile it) and doesn't fully implement MapComponent's pure virtuals (missing contains() and no-arg getWalkable() overrides - it declares a different-signature getWalkable(glm::vec3) instead). This is likely intentional in-progress work, not a bug to 'complete' unilaterally - leave alone unless a maintainer requests it or an issue is filed. Its include guard IS separately broken though (see issue #4).
